subject: Important Update: Changes to our Payment Process
body: Dear valued customers, We wanted to inform you of some important changes to our payment process. Starting next month, all invoices must be paid via our new online payment portal to ensure smooth and secure transactions. We appreciate your cooperation and understanding during this transition. If you have any questions or need assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to our customer support team. Thank you for your continued support. Best regards, The Billing Team
